title: Synergistic effect of the low-carbon city and sci-tech finance pilots on green innovation in China
core_idea: Examine whether and how China's low-carbon city (LCC) and sci-tech finance city (STFC) pilot policies, individually and jointly, influence green innovation, by exploring underlying mechanisms (government financial support for technology, environmental regulation, venture capital agglomeration), sequencing effects, and heterogeneity across cities.
tldr: Using panel data for 278 Chinese cities (2006–2021) and a multi-period difference‑in‑differences model, the study aims to assess impacts, mechanisms, synergistic interactions, sequencing, and heterogeneity of LCC and STFC pilot policies on substantive and strategic green innovation to inform policy design for sustainable urban development.
